# Maza Mediterranean Cuisine

Maza Mediterranean Cuisine is a family-owned, halal-certified Mediterranean restaurant in Chandler, Arizona, serving wraps, kebab plates, burgers, sides, and house-made desserts with big portions, real ingredients, and honest prices. The kitchen grills chicken, beef and lamb shish kebab, chicken and lamb tikka, ribeye tikka, and gyro to order, and every plate comes with rice, salad, hummus and tahini. Online ordering is available for pickup, along with delivery through Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Grubhub.

## Facts

- Name: Maza Mediterranean Cuisine
- Address: 3491 W Frye Rd, Suite 2, Chandler, AZ 85226, United States
- Phone: (480) 534-6550
- Hours: Tuesday through Sunday, 10:00am to 10:00pm. Closed Mondays.
- Cuisine: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Halal
- Price range: $$
- Ordering: takeout and delivery; catering available on request
